description.value:
♏ Scorpio is ascendant today. Your Cloth is awake and you have your Ascendant Boon for the whole day.

Needles land on any attack you make against a creature, hit or miss. Each needle deals @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage, stacking, to a maximum of ten needles' worth.

At 8 needles the creature must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or die. Incapacitation.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. Applied and removed by the module's sky tracker; a GM can also drag it on by hand.

rules.text: This attack applies a Scarlet Needle whether it hits or misses.
rules.title: Antares
